players.bio: Alexander Schlager is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for German Bundesliga club SV Werder Bremen and the Austria national team. He was the captain for Austria U-21 in Euro U-21 2019. On 16 November 2019, Schlager played his first match for Austria's national team in the deciding UEFA Euro 2020 qualifier against North Macedonia in Vienna.

Amos Pieper (born 17 January 1998) is a German professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. On 28 January 2019, Pieper moved from Borussia Dortmund II to 2. Bundesliga club Arminia Bielefeld. He made his professional debut for Bielefeld in the 2.
Cedric Jan Itten (born 27 December 1996) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for German 2. Bundesliga club Fortuna Düsseldorf and the Switzerland national team.

Iván San José Cantalejo (born 29 April 2004), commonly known as Chuki, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. Mainly an attacking midfielder, he can also play as a winger.
Dariusz Piotr Stalmach (born 8 December 2005) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder He is a Poland youth international.

Eren Sami Dinkçi (born 13 December 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or right winger for Bundesliga club 1. FC Heidenheim on loan from SC Freiburg. Born in Germany, he represented both Turkey and Germany internationally as a junior, before choosing to represent Turkey

Felix Agu (born 27 September 1999) is a German professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Werder Bremen. He has represented Germany internationally at U21 level. In late January 2020, media reported that Agu would move to Bundesliga side Werder Bremen for the 2020–21 season having agreed a four-year contract with the club.

Horst Steffen (born 3 March 1969) is a German football coach and a former player. He is currently the manager of Bundesliga club SV Werder Bremen. Steffen made ten appearances for the West Germany U21.

Jens Dalsgaard Stage (born 8 November 1996) is a Danish professional footballer who plays for Bundesliga side Werder Bremen. Stage is a versatile player, who has been deployed as a fullback, midfielder, winger and forward. Club career AGF On 27 January 2016, it was confirmed, that Stage had signed a contract with AGF. Previously, he played for Brabrand IF.

Julián Malatini (born 31 May 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back for Werder Bremen. Club career Malatini started out with Unión Deportiva de General Cabrera at the age of five, prior to joining Ateneo Vecinos. He left at the end of 2017 to sign for Talleres, having impressed over a trial period.

Justin Gideon Njinmah (born 15 November 2000) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. Career Njinmah is a former youth academy player of Eimsbütteler TV and Holstein Kiel. On 6 January 2022, he signed his professional contract with SV Werder Bremen and was immediately loaned out to Borussia Dortmund II.

Karl Jakob Hein (born 13 April 2002) is an Estonian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen, on loan from Premier League club Arsenal, and the Estonia national team.
Keke Maximilian Topp (born 25 March 2004) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen.
Leonardo Jesus Loureiro Bittencourt (born 19 December 1993) is a German professional footballer who plays for Werder Bremen, as a midfielder.

Ludovit Reis (born 1 June 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Jupiler Pro League club Club Brugge. He has Slovak descent, so he can still play for Slovakia national football team.
Marco Friedl (born 16 March 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen, which he captains, and the Austria national team.
Marco Grüll (born 6 July 1998) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen and the Austria national team.

Markus Kolke (born 18 August 1990) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. After playing in the lower tiers of German football, Kolke established himself as a starter for Wehen Wiesbaden in 2011. He played at the club for eight years, making 232 appearances and experiencing promotion to the 2. Bundesliga in his final season at the club.

Mitchell-Elijah Weiser (German pronunciation: ; born 21 April 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right back for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. On 10 January 2010, Weiser debuted in the U-16 Germany national team in a 6–0 against Cyprus. He scored his first goal for the U-17 team on 4 September 2010 in a 2–0 against Azerbaijan.

Niclas Füllkrug (born 9 February 1993) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club AC Milan, on loan from West Ham United, and the Germany national team. A Werder Bremen youth star, Füllkrug started his senior career with the club's reserves. Following appearances with the first team in the Bundesliga and a loan to 2.
Niklas Stark (born 14 April 1995) is a German professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen.
Olivier Deman (born 6 April 2000) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left midfielder or winger for German Bundesliga club Werder Bremen and the Belgium national team.

Senne Lynen (born 19 February 1999) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for German Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. Lynne spent his early career with Borsbeek Sport, Royal Antwerp, Westerlo, Lierse and Club Brugge.
Skelly Alvero (born 4 May 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen.

Stefan Smarkalev (Bulgarian: Стефан Смъркалев; born 14 May 2007) is a Bulgarian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Werder Bremen II. Career Smarkalev began his career at Botev Plovdiv Academy at the age of 7. He signed his first professional contract with the team in January 2023.
